exact_target: For every integer d >= 3 and integer q >= 3, the nearest-neighbor ferromagnetic zero-field q-state Potts model on Z^d, with unit interaction and monochromatic color-1 boundary condition, has positive spontaneous magnetization at its critical inverse temperature.
normalization: Using H=-sum_{<x,y>}1{sigma_x=sigma_y}, p=1-exp(-beta), m=(q*mu^1(sigma_0=1)-1)/(q-1)=phi^w_{p,q}(0 connected to infinity). Other simplex Hamiltonian conventions rescale beta.
